context: Sho and Hina return home from school.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. Small voice, no performance. Quiet certainty woven through—the comfortable truth of a good day. Gentle breath, steady pace.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright and unguarded, the way only an eight-year-old can be. Natural melody in her voice. Matches his warmth without thinking about it. Genuine smile audible.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Your family's really waiting for you, isn't it.
lines.style: Quiet and observant. Six-year-old precision—he's noticed something true and small says it plainly. Soft, tender recognition. No sadness, just gentle seeing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I really did try my best.
lines.style: Firm and bright, conviction in her voice. Eight-year-old certainty about her own effort. Not boastful—just clear. Natural rising warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft promise in a small voice. Not a question—a gentle statement of what he knows will happen. Warm, tender close. Breath slightly held, like protecting something precious.
